documentation.heading: OUTPUT SCHEMA — author one schema document using these forms:
documentation.introduction: The forms describe your envelope data, which is itself an ordinary JSON Schema document. Quoted values are literal choices; unquoted labels describe values to supply. NODE means one complete form below, nested where needed. FIELD means an arbitrary requested field name. Placeholders are notation, never output keys or values. Use actual JSON in your answer. array<T> means a JSON array of T values; | separates choices; ? marks an optional key. Only shown keys are allowed. Arrays may be empty unless minItems says otherwise.
